notes.zh-CN: 新增 Bot 自有技能（跨项目生效的 SKILL.md 导入）、排队消息主输入框整条编辑与草稿恢复、Bot 头像视线跟随；新装默认项目目录改为用户主目录。macOS 为 universal 开发签名、未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；Android APK 为调试签名；iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: Adds Bot-owned skills (import SKILL.md that apply in every project), full-composer editing of queued messages with draft restore, and pointer-following Bot avatar eyes; a fresh install now defaults the project folder to the user home. The universal macOS app is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
